dashboard.png.title: Front Matter Dashboard
dashboard.png.caption: I like using this dashboard as a homepage where I can easily view and add posts.

sidebar.png.title: Front Matter in the Sidebar
sidebar.png.caption: The sidebar lets you configure the front matter easily. The fields are loaded and populated through a predefined configuration.

field-action.png.title: "Add log number" field action
field-action.png.caption: Since I have GitHub Copilot enabled, I also have a Copilot field action.

custom-action.png.title: "Create image folder" custom action
custom-action.png.caption: You could also automate this script to run after creating posts but a button gives me control.

quote-snippet.gif.title: Quote snippet in action
quote-snippet.gif.caption: I can easily select the text, apply the quote snippet, and add the details, and it's converted to a shortcode. Less boilerplate for me!

figure-snippet.gif.title: Adding an image using the `Figure` snippet
figure-snippet.gif.caption: Note that I had already configured the title and the caption for the image in its metadata.

neovim.png.title: No I don't "use" NeoVim, I become NeoVim
neovim.png.caption: My NeoVim and Tmux setup. Minimal and functional.

orbstack.png.title: Orbstack is the new Docker Desktop
